title: Nvidia Rivals Intel and AMD With 128GB RTX Spark PCs
summary:
Several global PC manufacturers have started selling a new line of machines that can execute advanced AI models on-device. These RTX Spark PCs from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft, and MSI feature a custom chip integrating a CPU, GPU, and 128GB of unified memory to support AI development, creative workflows, and gaming on Windows.

Nvidia uses this hardware to expand CUDA adoption and compete directly with Intel and AMD in the premium laptop market. The systems enable developers to build AI agents locally using vLLM and scale workloads across Nvidia's cloud GPUs and more than 150M+ existing RTX PCs to drive future data center demand.
